title: "Data Driven UIs, Incrementally" by Yaron Minsky
summary: Yaron Minsky of Jane Street shows how the OCaml Incremental library lets trading UIs express data transformations that are easy to read and efficient on streaming data. It includes a live table demo.
why: Recommended in incremental computation and reactive UI threads as the best conceptual overview of Incremental and incr_dom.

quote.text: Any discussion about incremental UI should include Yaron Minsky's talk about Jane Street's OCaml framework, incr_dom from 2016
